description: #791 Markdown byte cap landing inside a consumer context window: the line-bounded renderer drops the whole fenced block instead of stopping inside it, so no fence is left open. Repo files and anchors are those of consumers-of-changed-keys.

repo_files.action.yml:
name: reviewer
description: Reviews pull requests.
inputs:
  evidence_providers_file:
    description: Provider definitions file.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: evidence
      shell: bash
      env:
        EVIDENCE_PROVIDERS_FILE: ${{ inputs.evidence_providers_file }}
      run: python3 scripts/run_evidence_providers.py
repo_files.contracts/action-v3.yml:
inputs:
  - id: model-name
    type: string
    description: Model to call.
  - id: evidence-providers-file
    type: path
    repo-configurable: true
    description: Provider definitions file.
  - id: sarif-files
    type: path
    description: SARIF inputs.
repo_files.scripts/check_review_needed.sh:
RESOLVED_PLATFORM="$(platform_resolve)"
if [[ "$RESOLVED_PLATFORM" == "forgejo" ]]; then
  echo forgejo
fi
